title: Holy Roman Empire
summary: The Holy Roman Empire officially lasted from 962, with the imperial coronation of Otto I, to 1806. It was one of Europe's largest medieval and early modern states, but not a unitary one: it was a confederation of small and medium-sized territories under an elected emperor. The Protestant Reformation broke out within it in 1517. From 1663 to 1806 its Perpetual Assembly met at Regensburg. It ended under pressure from Napoleon's France.

uncertainty.note: Established with Otto I's imperial coronation in 962 CE; officially dissolved in 1806 CE when Francis II abdicated.
